_doc: The two goals of this planet (design spec section 9; systems/restoration.gd). stage_values: what a city at each regrowth stage (0 polluted .. 5 thriving) is worth toward the launch point, 0..1; a city's value is stage_values[its stage] plus the step to the next value times its share toward the next stage, and launch progress is the mean over the cities. launch: the launch point, this planet's ending. when: 'all_districts_stage' = every city has reached `stage`. sequence: the cinematic that plays before the end screen (story/planet_ending.gd knows the ids; '' = none). planet: the long goal, never needed to move on. measure: 'cell_share_restored' = land hexes with their pollution gone over all land hexes of the globe. check_s: seconds between checks of the whole-planet share. steps[]: named marks along the way, in rising order: id (saved), name (shown on the map, translated where shown), share (0..1). A step at share 1.0 is the whole planet restored.
